“We're almost done, so you can take a break, Kasumi.”
Well then... I'm almost done here too.
“Hmph... a drink after work is the best, though.”
“I'll have a drink with you during dinner.”
“The cookies are tasty too. What an afternoon!”
“You've been here for a while now, how do you feel?”
“It's great. I'm really happy being here.”
“Haha, just kidding. No need to get flustered.”
“I just hope you can relax a bit more and consider this place your home.”
“I don't think so. I still feel like there's a bit of a barrier between you and us.”
“Or maybe it's just that we don't... you know... enough.”
“I'm heartbroken... I need a man to hold me~”
“Hehe... You're a good rebound, but what's more important is that you're cute.”
“But, you know... For example, like this plate of cookies and this cup of barley tea.”
“If I don't eat first, you won't eat, right?”
“And also, you always take a shower last, you never ask to watch the shows you want, and I've never seen you refuse any request.”
“You also wash your clothes separately from us.”
“And until now, we still don't know what you like to eat.”
“Because we're the boss, so you prioritize us, right?”
“Hehe, I don't mean anything else by it.”
Kasumi stands up and walks over to my side, then sits down.
I instinctively want to create some distance, but she supports my head with her hand.
And then, she gently pulls it down.
A fragrant scent rushes into my nose, and my head instantly feels a soft, fluffy wonderment...
“This place has changed ever since you got here.”
“The house has become so clean that it's hard to find any dust.”
“And most importantly, it seems like my sisters are starting to like it here.”
“When they first came back, their faces were full of gloom.”
“But now, they all smile when they mention your name.”
“Hehe, how long has it been since you slept?”
“At night, after we go back to our rooms, you come out to check the locks before going to sleep.”
“When you're tired, you should rest properly. Don't treat this job as just a job.”
“Rely on us more. Think of this as your real home.”
“I know you used to have a lot of jobs, so it's understandable that you want to make the guests happy.”
“Ayano used to like lying on my lap, and I would pat her head like this.”
“My parents never treated me like that.”
“Oh, I see... Well, feel free to come to me anytime for some affection.”
“Keep your voice down... {Me} finally fell asleep!”
“That sounds nice... I wanna lie down too.”
“Haha, next time. {Me} gets the lap pillow today.”
“Next time... you'll take care of me, {Me}.”
